SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntr:
TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over some intruder.
That's you, right?
SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou: TEAM ROCKET took off! You're our hero! Thank you!
SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro: I heard a kid was wandering around.
SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: It's not smart to pick a fight with TEAM ROCKET!
SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro: We study POKé BALL technology on this floor.
SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle: We worked on the ultimate POKé BALL which would catch anything.
SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonIntro:
Whaaat?
There shouldn't be any children here!
SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle: You're only on 5F. It's a long way to my BOSS!
SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!
SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
Which reminds me.
KOFFING evolves into WEEZING!
SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon:
It's a POKéMON REPORT!
POKéMON LAB created PORYGON, the first virtual-reality POKéMON.
SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirm:
It's a POKéMON REPORT!
Over 350 POKéMON techniques have been confirmed.
SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded:
It's a POKéMON REPORT!
Some POKéMON have been confirmed to evolve when they are traded.
SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStro:
Those thugs that took over our building…
Their BOSS said he was looking for strong POKéMON.
I hope our PRESIDENT managed to avoid trouble…
